entities.summary: The South West Africa National Union (SWANU) is a Namibian political party founded in 1959. Most of its members came from the Herero people, while fellow independence movement SWAPO was mostly an Ovambo party. South West Africa National Union is a political party in Africa, established in 1959-09-27. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
